description: pkix-chain/src/lib.rs:137 says 'NoRevocation, CrlChecker, and OcspChecker all inherit this default, so the last cert is not actively checked unless you override the method'. This is factually wrong: CrlChecker and OcspChecker both DO override check_revocation_against_anchor (as also stated in pkix-revocation/src/lib.rs:288 and crl.rs:332). The pkix-chain verify_chain docstring misstates the behavior. Fix the docstring.
title: pkix-revocation: doc says check_revocation_against_anchor default is skip, but CrlChecker/OcspChecker DO override it
